play.definition: A special-teams recovery play in which the receiving team uses a hands-team alignment and coordinated recovery technique to secure a deliberately short kickoff after the ball becomes legally recoverable, while nearby teammates screen or block coverage players away from the recovery point.

action.label: Attempt Recovery
action.definition: A player's deliberate effort to gain possession of a loose or kicked football by reaching, diving, falling on, trapping, or grasping the ball before an opponent secures it.

action.label: Kick Approach
action.definition: The kicker's controlled run-up or step sequence toward the football before making contact on a kickoff, onside kick, free kick, or placekick.

action.label: Kick Ball
action.definition: A kicker's action of striking the football with the foot to initiate a kickoff, field-goal attempt, extra-point attempt, free kick, or other legal kicking play.

action.label: None
action.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

action.label: Pre Snap
action.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.
